metadata.description: Open-source skills for Claude Code and other agent CLIs that read the Agent Skills format.

plugins.name: ghana-data-protection-policies
plugins.description: Writes and audits privacy policies, terms of service, and cookie policies for products processing personal data in Ghana, grounded in a scan of the target codebase and Ghana's Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843).

plugins.name: fix-vulns
plugins.description: Audits and fixes vulnerable dependencies in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Java/Kotlin and .NET projects (Dependabot alerts plus each ecosystem's own auditor) on a dedicated branch. Judges which flaws are actually reachable, applies the smallest safe upgrades, validates against a pre-upgrade baseline, and reports what was and was not fixed. Never commits or pushes without approval.
